DATA-02.limitations: The forecasting data (speeds, weather, collisions, events, 311) were downloaded on the author's workstation; speed-links --since 2026-01-01 timed out server-side 6x, so the link set is 'active since 2026-09-20' (125 links citywide, 26 in Manhattan). On 2026-10-21 the development container reached NYC Open Data and re-downloaded the speed-link set (same 125 links; graph hash d8c69a468b82cbda reproduced), the Manhattan ATR counts 2009-2026 (per-year counts equal the server-side counts) and the West St OSM extract (OSM editing API; Overpass blocked).

PAPER-01.limitations: Results, discussion, limitations and conclusion (including the superseded SUMO comparison and the testbed audit) are written from the run artifacts and listed in paper_claims.csv; 24/24 references CHECKED. Author block filled with the student (S K Sricharan, VIT Chennai); co-authors and author order (e.g. the guide) are to be confirmed by the authors before submission.

SIM-02.limitations: The 45 matched-seed runs in simulation_metrics.csv (2026-10-20) are SUPERSEDED: the 2026-10-21 testbed audit (reports/experiments/simulation_testbed_audit.json) found bare from/to flows re-routed by SUMO at insertion (1,120 of 2,189 mainline routes off West Street) and a 0.2 m NB entry stub. Under the corrected protocol (fixed routes, observed ATR mainline demand) no side-demand level passes the preregistered baseline test with either the netconvert programs or Webster re-timed programs (simulation/scenarios/demand_selection_*.json), so the corrected controller comparison is NOT_RUN.
